PTSettingInformationContent: PT Settings of main bettypes are also applied to other bettypes as following:
CommissionMap: M = Master, A = Agent, P = Member.
MPS15: - The Saba Futsal uses the bet settings of Saba Soccer.
MPS16: - The Saba Cricket uses the bet settings of Other Sports.
MPS17: Accumulated max payout counts all running tickets. It will be released if any running tickets are settled/rejected/refunded/voided.
MPS19: - Parlay Max Payout Per Bet: This setting is used to calculate the max bet of each combo parlay in a single ticket.
MPS20: 1. Given that the Parlay Max Payout Setting is:Single Match Parlay = 400, Combo 2 = 500; Combo 3-5 = 1,000; Combo 6+ & System Parlay  = 2,000
MPS21: 2. If member makes 3 selections: A (odds = 2), B (odds = 3), C (odds = 4), the system will offer the following combos: Double (3 Bets), Treble (1 Bet), Trixie (4 Bets) and Lucky 7 (7 Bets)
MPS22: 3. Max Bet of 3 Double bets = Parlay Max Payout of Combo 2 / (odds AB + odds BC + odds AC) = 500 / (2*3 + 3*4 + 2*4) = 500 / 26 = 19
MPS23: 4. Max Bet of a Treble bet = Parlay Max Payout of Combo 3-5 / odds ABC = 1,000 / (2*3*4) = 1000 / 24 = 41
MPS24: 5. Max Bet of Trixie and Lucky 7 bets =  Parlay Max Payout of Combo 6+ & System Parlay / (odds Double + odds Treble) = 2,000 / (26 + 24) = 2000 / 50 = 40
MPS24_1: 6. If member selects 5 selections across 3 matches with final odds = 20, Max Bet of Bet Builder<sup>+</sup> = Parlay Max Payout of Combo 3-5 / final odds = 1000 / 20 = 50
MPS24_2: 7. If member selects 5 selections within one match and the final odds = 4, Max Bet of Bet Builder<sup>+</sup> = Parlay Max Payout of Single Match Parlay / final odds = 400 / 4 = 100

MaxWinSettingInformationContent_0: - Max Win Per Match is a setting that controls the maximum total winnings across all tickets of the same match.
MaxWinSettingInformationContent_1:
For example:
1. Given that max win per match = 1,000
2. If member places the first ticket with Odds = 11, Stake = 70, the ticket will have:
- Max Bet = Max Win Per Match / (Odds-1) = 1,000 / (11-1) = 100.
- Max Win = Stake * (Odds-1) = 70 * (11-1) = 700 = Accumulated Max Win*
3. If member places the second ticket with Odds = 6, the ticket will have:
- Max Bet = (Max Win Per Match - Accumulated Max Win) / (Odds-1)= (1,000 - 700) / (6-1) = 60.
MaxWinSettingInformationContent_2: * Accumulated Max Win is the Max Win of all tickets of the same match excludes the Void/Reject tickets. Therefore, if the first ticket is voided, Max Bet of the second ticket = (1,000 - 0)/(6-1) = 200.
MaxWinSettingInformationContent_3: - Parlay Max Win Per Match: The system accumulates the max win of all running parlay tickets and uses it together with the setting value to calculate the next ticket max bet. The max bet calculation is different between Single Match Parlay and Mix/Combo Parlay/Bet Builder<sup>+</sup>.
MaxWinSettingInformationContent_4:
+ Single Match Parlay: Max Bet = (Parlay Max Win Per Match Setting - Accumulated Max Win of the same match) / (Odds-1)
* Single Match Parlay does not count Mix/Combo Parlay/Bet Builder+ ticket
MaxWinSettingInformationContent_5:
+ Mix/Combo Parlay/Bet Builder+: Max Bet = (Parlay Max Win Per Match Setting - Accumulated Max Win of the all matches) / (Odds-1)
* Mix/Combo Parlay/Bet Builder+ does not count Single Match Parlay tickets
MaxWinSettingInformationContent_6:
Accumulated Max Win counts all running tickets. It will be released if any running tickets are settled/rejected/refunded/voided.
* For parlay, Max Win is applied to all bet types.
